description: Defines test classes and utilities for disk cache testing in Chromium, including DiskCacheTest and DiskCacheTestWithCache, with methods for cache management, iteration, and test setup.

classes.name: DiskCacheTest
classes.description: Base class for disk cache related tests, managing cache directory setup and cleanup.

classes.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache
classes.description: Derived class providing additional support for cache operations, iteration, and test control.

classes.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache::TestIterator
classes.description: Helper class for iterating over cache entries during tests.

methods.name: CopyTestCache
methods.description: Copies cache files from data folder to test folder.

methods.name: CleanupCacheDir
methods.description: Deletes contents of the cache directory.

methods.name: CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates cache backend with specified flags.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry by key.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over cache entries.
